_comment: TIER 3 slot — the thread-first Ship UI. The implementation files (a small no-framework server + a data-free shell + service worker + icons + status-surface.md) ship on the stacked UI PR, which fills this folder, and are VENDORED from a live ship's ui/thread/ once the Captain locks that seed as the base (not yet locked — see status-surface.md 'Vendoring'). This manifest reserves the tier so presets.json can reference 'ui' and shipkit_init.py installs it once the files land. The UI consumes the thread log + status.json contract (lib/status.schema.md) + the inbox/drops/ steer path at runtime — it does NOT import lib/ Python. That makes ui a runtime-orders-after dependency on autonomous (state must exist), expressed here as requires[]. The drop shape the steer box writes is a per-deployment config seam the vendored UI must expose (see status-surface.md).
name: ui
